business_problem: IATA wanted a repeatable short-term air-travel forecasting signal to complement long-term econometric models, but needed the entire workflow to run automatically each month with richer features and no manual intervention.
solution_summary: IATA uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: IATA wanted a repeatable short-term air-travel forecasting signal to complement long-term econometric models, but needed the entire workflow to run automatically each month with richer features and no manual intervention. Cloud Scheduler triggers the monthly forecasting run without manual intervention, serving as the orchestration layer. Cloud Run functions start the execution flow that publishes the orchestration message, serving as the serving layer. Pub/Sub carries the event that wakes up the forecasting pipeline, serving as the orchestration layer. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform orchestrates the machine-learning workflow with Kubeflow, serving as the orchestration layer. Cloud Storage stores the retrieved monthly data and intermediate assets for preprocessing and training, serving as the storage layer. Secret Manager stores the credentials used to authenticate data retrieval securely, serving as the governance layer.
